brief:
Mondoweiss reports that American political and corporate figures are restricting pro-Palestine advocacy despite the country's stated commitment to free speech. The outlet cites cases involving musicians, online personalities, and grassroots activists who face pressure for expressing support for Palestinian causes, including calls to "Free Palestine."

The reporting suggests a pattern where billionaires and politicians use their influence to silence Palestinian solidarity messaging, contradicting American free speech principles. Advocates argue the suppression must end so pro-Palestine voices can be heard without institutional interference.
dek: Whether it’s Macklemore, Hasan Piker, or your neighborhood activist, this is a fight to make sure billionaires and politicians cannot stop free speech and will have to hear the calls to “Free Palestine” whether they like it or not.
title: U.S. suppresses pro-Palestine speech while claiming to defend free expression
